subject: Request: Executive approval — Concierge+ support + integration credit for Solara Health
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Solara — request for Concierge+ + integration credit (need exec ok)

Team,

Quick summary: Solara Health (payer analytics platform) is ready to sign but procurement pushed back on the bundled onboarding fee. They want Concierge+ (12 months premium support) rolled into the contract + a $42k integration credit for 3rd-party data pipeline work we’d normally bill as professional services. Net new ARR is $480k (annual), but margin on this customer will be depressed in year 1 if we absorb the credit.

What I'm requesting: executive sign-off to approve: 
- Complimentary Concierge+ for 12 months (standard list: $60k/yr)
- One-time integration credit: $42,000 applied to Professional Services line
- 90-day pilot SLA ramp with reduced token caps for first month (operational fallback)

Rationale:
- Strategic vertical entry (payer analytics), strong reference potential and >75% chance of expansion in 12–18 months.
- Procurement is firm on start-of-quarter PO; losing this slides the deal by 3–4 months and likely reduces long-term expansion.

Impact & ask:
- Revenue impact year 1 (approx): -$42k PS credit + $60k support waived = $102k contra against initial revenue.
- We can structure as a 12-month credit amortized on the invoice schedule to preserve sales commission accounting.

Attachments: SOW draft (Solara_SOW_v1.pdf), proposed pricing worksheet.

If we can get sign-off today, I’ll send the updated contract to procurement and route for signature.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Solara — request for Concierge+ + integration credit (need exec ok)

Rachel — thanks for the summary. A few quick questions before I take this up to Rev Ops/Deal Desk:

1) Can we split the $42k credit between a PS discount and deferred payment? If we amortize $20k over the first two invoices and discount $22k, it lowers up-front cash impact.
2) Is there a firm commitment in the SOW for a 24-month term or expansion minimum? We should attach an expansion guardrail if we're giving this much concession.
3) Any technical risk that will require extra SE hours beyond the credit? If so, we should add an hourly cap.

Also please include a short bullet for top-level execs: why Solara matters (customer logo, estimated expansion, reference use case). I’ll draft a short cover note and escalate to Marcus for approval.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-17T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Solara — request for Concierge+ + integration credit (need exec ok)

Agree with Ben's approach. I'm prepared to approve the concession under these conditions: 

- Approve Concierge+ waived for first 12 months contingent on execution of SOW v1 and signed PO within 7 calendar days.
- Approve a $30k immediate credit to PS line; remaining $12k must be converted to a time-and-materials cap (billed as incurred) and documented in the SOW.
- Add expansion commitment: 18-month minimum term or a mid-term review with automatic renewal clause unless terminated.
- Add a technical hours cap: 120 SE hours included; any additional hours billed at standard rates.

Ben — can you prepare a single redline that reflects the $30k credit + $12k T&M cap and expansion language? Rachel — please update the SOW and confirm the PO timeline. If procurement can sign in the week, I’ll route for final Exec sign-off.

Marcus Lin
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@solarahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Tom Greer <tom.greer@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@solarahealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Solara — request for Concierge+ + integration credit (need exec ok)

Rachel — thanks for moving quickly. We appreciate the flexibility. Procurement has agreed in principle to the $30k credit and will accept the remaining $12k as an invoiced cap against actual hours. We can commit to the 18-month term as requested.

Next steps on our side:
- Procurement to send PO by EOD Friday (2027-03-19) with the agreed commercial terms.
- We need the updated SOW and invoice schedule before we route to legal.

Attachments: internal procurement checklist (not shared)

Best,
Elena Torres
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Solara Health
